description: Creates a goal with POST /goals/create using the test key. No money moves. Returns goalId, paymentUrl (hosted checkout) and clientSecret (embedded checkout). Amounts are integer cents, USD.

callbackUrl.description: Where the buyer returns after confirming; localhost is allowed in test mode

deadline.description: ISO 8601 due date, 24h to 2 years out (one-time goals only)

depositAmount.description: Upfront card charge in cents. One-time: ≥ 50 and < targetAmount. Subscription: = targetAmount or omit

description.description: What the buyer is saving for, max 500 characters

frequency.description: Makes it a recurring subscription; omit for a one-time purchase

metadata.description: Echoed verbatim in every webhook, e.g. { orderId }

name: create_test_goal
title: Create a sandbox goal
